definitions.explanation: The respiratory organs on the sides of fish (and some other aquatic animals) that allow them to extract oxygen from water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧えら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}する→呼吸する：25333_kokyuusuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧えら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
examples.english: A fresh fish has red gills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧えら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{内臓|ないぞう}→内臓：05028_naizou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いた→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧。
examples.english: Before cooking, I cleanly removed the fish's gills and innards.

notes:
Written in kanji as {鰓|えら}, but the kana form is more common in everyday writing. Used both literally for fish anatomy and metaphorically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- えら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}する→呼吸する：25333_kokyuusuru⟧: to breathe through gills
- えら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove the gills (in fish preparation)
- ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧えら: red gills (a sign of freshness)

USAGE:
えら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ can describe a person with a wide jaw or angular jawline (literally "the jaw/gill juts out"). In this use えら refers to the angle of the jaw, not the fish organ.
